headlines.title: 法国央行就债务问题发表声明，驳斥“虚假信息”
headlines.summary: 法国央行发表声明，否认其在市场上出售了债务持仓，此前该央行遭到让-吕克·梅朗雄及其极左翼政党的批评。 该声明是对埃里克·科克雷尔言论的回应，后者称法国央行持有的证券投资组合出现了“令人担忧”的缩减。 法国央行表示，“自收购以来，这些证券均未在市场上出售”，并愿意向国民议会财政委员会解释其货币政策操作。

headlines.title_en: France's central bank issues a statement on debt issues, refuting 'false information'
headlines.summary_en: The Bank of France issued a statement denying that it had sold debt holdings in the market, after the central bank came under criticism from Jean-Luc Mélenchon and his far-left party. The statement was a response to remarks by Eric Coquerel, who said the securities portfolio held by the Bank of France had shrunk in a "worrying" way. The Bank of France said that "since acquisition, none of these securities have been sold on the market," and that it was willing to explain its monetary policy operations to the National Assembly's finance committee.

headlines.title: China’s factory-gate price growth picks up in August as Iran war fuels energy volatility
headlines.summary:
China’s factory-gate price growth accelerated in August, while consumer inflation picked up again, amid volatile energy and commodity costs linked to the US-Israel war on Iran.
The producer price index rose 3.8 per cent year on year last month, up from 3.5 per cent in July, according to data released by the National Bureau of Statistics (NBS) on Wednesday.
The reading beat a 3.6 per cent projection from economists polled by financial data provider Wind.

headlines.title_en: New Delhi Declaration of the 18th BRICS Leaders' Summit (summary): affirms the work of the 7 special working groups under the BRICS industrial channel, and affirms the efforts of the smart manufacturing and robotics working group in smart factory development, solution sharing, standards cooperation and talent training
headlines.summary_en: New Delhi Declaration of the 18th BRICS Leaders' Meeting (Summary): Affirmed the work of the seven special working groups under the BRICS industrial channel, and affirmed the efforts of the smart manufacturing and robotics working group in areas such as smart factory development, solution sharing, standards cooperation, and talent training. Recognized that artificial intelligence provides enormous opportunities for promoting economic growth and achieving sustainable development. Pointed out that using artificial intelligence to promote economic growth and social well-being is crucial for advancing countries, especially Global South countries, toward a just, fair, equal, and prosperous future. Affirmed the Shanghai World AI Conference and the High-Level Meeting on Global AI Governance, and recognized their contributions to strengthening international AI cooperation and AI for good. (Xinhua News Agency)

headlines.title: Beijing can rewrite China’s property rules, but it can’t undo the damage
headlines.summary:
Financial markets are notoriously prone to mistaking a fundamental institutional shift for a temporary liquidity crisis. The futurist Roy Amara is often credited with the observation that people tend to overestimate the short-term effect of a transformation while underestimating its long-term impact. China’s real-estate sector is furnishing a textbook case of an analogous dynamic.
On August 28, Chinese housing authorities and financial regulators announced a package to overhaul the commercial...
headlines.title_zh: 北京可以改写中国的房地产规则，但无法消除造成的损害
headlines.summary_zh: 金融市场出了名地容易把根本性的制度转变误认为暂时的流动性危机。未来学家Roy Amara常被认为提出了这样的观察：人们往往高估一项变革的短期影响，而低估其长期影响。中国的房地产行业正提供一个教科书式的案例。

headlines.title: 中信建投：加息“靴子”将落地，A股或迎反攻行情
headlines.summary: 中信建投研报表示，对于当前的A股和美股来说，加息预期的分歧让投资者感到无所适从，而加息“靴子落地”则能够凝聚共识，开启新一轮行情。本周五A股在四大利空冲击下实现V型反弹，结合未来美联储加息靴子将落地，A股周四大幅缩量和科技板块相对充分的调整，中信建投认为A股有望迎来变盘时点，或将开启反攻行情。配置上依然均衡配置+灵活调整：1.以通信、电子等高景气行业作为当前进攻核心品种，并适当调升仓位；2.以银行、保险等低估值红利板块作为防御性底仓品种；3.关注油气开采、煤化工、煤炭、油服工程、航运港口在高油价持续下的受益机会。

headlines.title_en: CSC: The rate hike "shoe" is about to drop, and A-shares may usher in a counterattack rally
headlines.summary_en: A CITIC Securities research report says that for current A-shares and US stocks, disagreement over rate hike expectations has left investors at a loss, while the rate hike "shoe dropping" can forge consensus and kick off a new round of gains. Last Friday, A-shares staged a V-shaped rebound under the impact of four major negatives. Combined with the imminent Fed rate hike, a sharp drop in A-share volume on Thursday and a relatively full correction in the tech sector, CITIC Securities believes A-shares may be approaching a turning point and could launch a counterattack. On allocation, still balance exposure + adjust flexibly: 1. Use high-growth industries such as communications and electronics as the core offensive holdings now, and appropriately raise positions; 2. Use low-valuation dividend sectors such as banks and insurance as defensive base holdings; 3. Watch opportunities in oil and gas exploration, coal chemicals, coal, oilfield services and engineering, and shipping ports from sustained high oil prices.

headlines.summary: 瑞典议会选举13日上午开始投票。此次选举将产生新一届全国议会，并影响未来瑞典政府组成和政策走向。瑞典广播电台12日公布的大选前最后一轮民调结果显示，社会民主党以28.6%的支持率位居第一；普遍被认为属极右翼的瑞典民主党支持率为18.3%，位居第二；现任首相乌尔夫·克里斯特松领导的温和党以16.8%的支持率位居第三。瑞典议会共有349个议席，每4年举行一次选举。（新华社）

headlines.title_en: Sweden's parliamentary election begins voting
headlines.summary_en: Sweden's parliamentary election began voting on the morning of the 13th. The election will produce a new national parliament and affect the future composition of Sweden's government and policy direction. The last round of pre-election polling released by Swedish Radio on the 12th showed the Social Democrats in first place with 28.6% support; the Sweden Democrats, widely regarded as far-right, in second with 18.3%; and the Moderate Party led by incumbent Prime Minister Ulf Kristersson in third with 16.8%. Sweden's parliament has 349 seats, with elections held every four years. (Xinhua News Agency)

headlines.title: 上海“明珠星座计划”正式启动，目标建设吉瓦级天基计算星座
headlines.summary: 9月13日，2026浦江创新论坛“太空算力产业生态论坛”在上海举行。“明珠星座计划”正式启动。该计划长期目标是建设吉瓦级天基计算星座，围绕国产算力载荷、光计算载荷、新型能源系统等方向开展在轨验证，随后逐步进入首批卫星部署和规模组网阶段，计划到2030年逐步建成全球覆盖、天地协同、自主可控的太空智能算力基础设施和服务网络。

headlines.title_en: Shanghai's "Pearl Constellation Plan" is officially launched, aiming to build a gigawatt-level space-based computing constellation
headlines.summary_en: On September 13, the 2026 Pujiang Innovation Forum's "Space Computing Industry Ecosystem Forum" was held in Shanghai. The "Pearl Constellation Plan" was officially launched. The plan's long-term goal is to build a gigawatt-level space-based computing constellation, carrying out in-orbit verification around domestic computing payloads, optical computing payloads, new energy systems and other directions, then gradually entering the first batch of satellite deployment and large-scale networking stages, with plans to gradually build a globally covered, space-ground coordinated, independently controllable space intelligent computing infrastructure and service network by 2030.

headlines.title_en: Xi Jinping meets with Indian Prime Minister Modi
headlines.summary_en: According to Xinhua News Agency, on the afternoon of September 12 local time, President Xi Jinping met with Indian Prime Minister Modi during the 18th BRICS Leaders' Meeting in New Delhi, India. The leaders of the two countries had a candid and in-depth exchange of views and reached an important consensus that China and India should be partners. Xi Jinping pointed out that China has always viewed and developed China-India relations from a strategic height and long-term perspective. Over the past two years, I have met with Prime Minister Modi twice, guiding China-India relations from "starting anew" to achieving "further elevation." Institutional exchanges between the two countries have gradually resumed, the cooperation list has continued to lengthen, and bilateral trade volume has hit a new high. This situation has not come easily and is worth cherishing. China and India have different national conditions, and can fully draw on each other's strengths, support each other, enable each other's success, and develop together. In the face of a turbulent and intertwined international situation, China and India, as the world's two most populous countries and important members of the Global South, shoulder important responsibilities. headlines.title: 我国实现一体化算力统筹监测
headlines.summary: 从工业和信息化部了解到，中国算力平台已实现全国一体化算力统筹监测，我国算力“一张网、一盘棋、一体化”发展格局基本形成。中国算力平台是国家级综合性算力服务平台，目前已经汇聚了超万家注册企业用户，上架2000多项优质算力产品，接入各类大模型超300个，为广大开发者提供算力调用服务，累计沉淀数十亿条算力监测大数据。（央视新闻）

headlines.title_en: China achieves integrated coordinated monitoring of computing power
headlines.summary_en: Learned from the Ministry of Industry and Information Technology that China's computing power platform has achieved nationwide integrated computing power coordinated monitoring, and the development pattern of "one network, one chessboard, integration" for China's computing power has basically taken shape. China's computing power platform is a national-level comprehensive computing power service platform. It has currently gathered more than 10,000 registered enterprise users, listed more than 2,000 high-quality computing power products, connected more than 300 large models of various types, provided computing power invocation services for developers, and accumulated billions of pieces of computing power monitoring big data. (CCTV News)

headlines.summary_en: [Shenyang Blower Works Group: IPO and main board listing] Shenyang Blower Works Group (601091.SH) announced that its application for an initial public offering and main board listing has been approved for registration by the CSRC. The number of shares in this public offering is 311 million, accounting for 10% of the total share capital after issuance, at an issue price of 4.39 yuan per share and an issue price-to-earnings ratio of 29.81 times.
